const x1: { [k: string]: any } = "abc";
const x2: { [k: number]: string } = "abc";
const x3: { [k: string]: unknown } = 1;
const x4: Record<string, unknown> = true;
const x5: { [k: number]: unknown } = [1, 2];
const x6: Record<string, unknown> = () => 1;
function g() { return 1; }
const x7: Record<string, unknown> = g;
type F = () => number;
const f: F = () => 1;
const x8: Record<string, unknown> = f;
const x9: Record<string, unknown> = { a: 1, b: "c" };
type O = { [k: string]: O | number };
const o: O = { k: "s" };
